[[sn:Tibetan Library]]Perched high in the towering peaks of a mountain range, the Tibetan Library is a sanctuary of knowledge and wisdom. But beneath its serene facade, an unnatural, chilling winter holds the grand monastery in its icy grip. Navigating its sacred halls, players will confront their inner angsts, symbolized by a spectral entity, using the power of ancient mantras. This dungeon emphasizes inner peace and turmoil, drawing inspiration from the tranquility of Tibetan monasteries.

== Background ==
Long ago, when the world was younger and spiritual energy flowed more freely, the guardian spirit, the Snow Leopard, shaped a refuge high in the mountains. The Tibetan Library was established as a testament to wisdom, knowledge, and inner peace. Over time, monks and scholars from distant lands sought solace here, enriching the library with their teachings.

== Location ==
Set within the embrace of the majestic [[Monastic Peaks]], the Tibetan Library is a grand Tibetan Buddhist monastery. Its towering spires and ornate designs beckon those seeking enlightenment.

== Aspect ==
Represented by Inner Dialogue (Angst Vaccine), this location encapsulates the battle between inner peace and the turmoil that often clouds the mind.

== Dungeon Item ==
After vanquishing the midboss, the [[Snow Leopard]], adventurers acquire the [[Mantra Wheel]]. This artifact is instrumental in not only navigating the wintry labyrinth but also unlocking the monastery's hidden truths.

== Key Object ==
The [[Prayer Wheels/Flags]] scattered throughout the monastery play an essential role in the dungeon's puzzles. They aid in manipulating the environment, revealing hidden paths, and activating ancient mechanisms.

== Midboss ==
Roaming the snow-clad corridors is the fierce [[Snow Leopard]], the monastery's guardian spirit. While a symbol of inner peace and solitude, it now challenges those who wish to restore the library's sanctity.

== Boss ==
The haunting presence of [[The Anxious Apparition]], a being that thrives on angst, looms large over the Tibetan Library. This spectral entity has enveloped the monastery in a chilling, perpetual winter, representing the internal struggles one faces against anxiety and fear.

== Dungeon Description ==
The Tibetan Library, with its tranquil courtyards and wisdom-laden halls, is an intricate maze. Players must harness the power of the Mantra Wheel to traverse the icy paths, reveal frost-covered secrets, and manipulate wind-based puzzles. The ultimate objective is to harness the melodies of the Mantra Wheel, dispelling the icy grasp of the Anxious Apparition and bringing warmth back to the monastery.

== Surrounding Location ==
The surrounding [[Monastic Peaks]] rise tall and majestic around the Tibetan Library. Each peak serves as a hermitage for ancient monastic hermits, offering players insights and unique challenges.

== Guardian Spirit ==
The elusive [[Snow Leopard]], revered for its mysterious nature, stands as the guardian of these sacred heights. It embodies the spirit of inner peace, solitude, and the resilience of the high mountains.

== Exploration of Theme ==
This dungeon delves deep into the concepts of inner peace versus turmoil. The ever-present Anxious Apparition serves as a reflection of one's inner demons and anxieties.
*** '''Enhancements:'''
*** Introducing mirrored rooms or sections within the dungeon enhances the theme of self-reflection and internal dialogue.
*** Throughout their journey, players can uncover 'wisdom scrolls', shedding light on the Apparition's internal battles and providing clues for their final confrontation.
